name: Tucson & Saguaro National Park
summary: The Sonoran Desert city — forests of giant saguaro, a spectacular desert museum, and a gleaming white Spanish mission. The last stop before California.

lodging.name: A Tucson desert resort or downtown hotel
lodging.blurb: Near the saguaros and the historic barrio.

foodMustTry.name: A Sonoran hot dog & a chimichanga
foodMustTry.blurb: Tucson is a UNESCO City of Gastronomy — and claims the chimichanga.

item.title: Saguaro National Park
item.blurb: Drive and walk among forests of the giant saguaro that symbolize the West — the park flanks the city in two districts.

item.title: Arizona-Sonora Desert Museum
item.blurb: Part zoo, part botanical garden, part museum — the best introduction to the Sonoran Desert's life.

days.label: Day 420 — The White Dove
days.summary: A Spanish mission and the old city.

item.title: Mission San Xavier del Bac

location.name: Mission San Xavier del Bac
location.address: 1950 W San Xavier Rd, Tucson, AZ

item.blurb: The dazzling white 'White Dove of the Desert,' a 1797 Spanish colonial mission still in use.

item.title: Downtown Tucson & Sabino Canyon

location.name: Sabino Canyon
location.address: 5900 N Sabino Canyon Rd, Tucson, AZ

item.blurb: The historic barrio and food scene, plus a tram into cactus-studded Sabino Canyon.

days.label: Day 421 — West to California
days.summary: Across to San Diego — the Southwest is done.

commute.scenicNote: West on I-8 across the desert to the Pacific and California.
